rationale: Archive Akumin from the direct-infrastructure PortCo list and retract its Stonepeak PortCo ownership row. The ownership itself is real, but the operating business is principally healthcare services and therefore fails the census infrastructure-scope test.

supports: Stonepeak became the 100% common owner on February 6, 2024
Akumin earns revenue from imaging, oncology and outsourced clinical services
Akumin is not a qualifying direct infrastructure platform

companyFieldUpdates.description: Akumin provides outpatient diagnostic imaging, radiation oncology and outsourced clinical services to patients, physician groups, hospitals and health systems. Stonepeak became its 100% common owner on February 6, 2024, but the company is outside the direct-infrastructure PortCo census because its principal business is healthcare service delivery rather than ownership and operation of a qualifying infrastructure platform.

set.event: Akumin completed its acquisition of Alliance HealthCare Services with financing from Stonepeak Magnet Holdings and Stonepeak Infrastructure Fund IV.
Akumin completed its restructuring, cancelled legacy equity and became wholly owned by Stonepeak at the common-equity level.
